tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru buddhā bo dhi satwe bhyaḥ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa mchog gi bdud rtsis yang dag par ngom pa'i dam pa rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig phun tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /bla med go 'phang yid bzhin nor/ /'gro ba kun la nyer stsol ba/ /bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /kun khyab dbyings ni rnam pa thams cad pa/ /sems nyid rang bzhin yon tan kun gyi gter/ /dbyer med gdod nas rnam grol chos kyi sku/ /nang rig 'gyur med don dam rgyal gyur cig /gang yang rgyud sde'i chu bo 'bum phrag gis/ /blo yi mtsho chen bres las mngon 'phags pa/ /de las snying gi bum pa gang gyur pa'i/ /gdams pa'i rgyun gyis phyogs 'di skal bzang bya/ /'dir mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bla na med pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mchog mthar thug /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma lus pa'i 'jug ngogs/ khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus dang ldan par gang zag rnams tshe gcig lus gcig skye ba gcig nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu mchog la yang dag par 'god nus pa'i nye lam myur lam khyad par can/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan du ma rnams su rdo rje'i tshig gi sbas pa'i don/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud du ma sbas shing gsal bar bstan la/ mchog gi dang po sangs rgyas la sogs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa thams cad du dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis bstan pa'i don mchog phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'am/

zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yid ches pa rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa'i lam yin no/ /'di lta bus 'khrid par byed pa la/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi snod du rung bar byed pa sngon 'gro'i 'khrid dang*/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dngos gzhi sgom pa'i rim pa dang*/ rjes lam gyi yan lag sa mtshams/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs pa dang bcas pa ste gsum las/ dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po thun mong gi sngon 'gro la/ chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs shing byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa maṇḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa zhes dmigs bskor gsum du mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ rim pa'i myong 'khrid skyong pa la dmigs bskor lngar byas na bde bas/ 'di ltar bya ste/ chos spyi'i rtsa ba skyabs 'gro'i 'khrid/ theg chen kyi rtsa ba sems bskyed kyi 'khrid/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba yig brgya'i 'khrid/ tshogs bsags pa maṇḍal gyi 'khrid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid de lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la lus gnad dkyus mthun tsam byas/ sems rnal du phab nas/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid dag pa'i zhing khams chen po yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i dbus su/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bzang gzhal med khang rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ de'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu rab tu rgyas pa/ /de'i rtse mo la seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi ma zla ba rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan dpangs mtho zhing rgya che ba la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/

yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ shing de'i rtsa ba na/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyang bdag la skyob pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi phyogs bzhir gzhal yas khang gi nang gi sa gzhi la seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan dpangs mtho zhing rgya che ba re re gsal btab ste/ bla ma'i sku'i mdun gyi phyogs su dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sogs phyogs bcu dus gsum kyi sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnams dang*/ g.yas phyogs su 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams dang*/ g.yon phyogs su shā ri'i bu la sogs pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ rgyab phyogs su chos dkon mchog rnams rnam pa glegs bam gyi tshul can rnams bzhugs par mos/ yang na rgyab tu sangs rgyas dang*/ mdun du dam chos bzhugs par mos kyang chog ste/ blo la gang bde ba zhig bya'o/ /de nas rang dang lhan cig tu mkha' mnyam kyi sems can thams cad kyang*/ bla ma dkon mchog skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mos gus kyi gdung ba chen pos skyabs 'gro byed pa mos shing*/ khyad par sems can thams cad la snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab tu gsol snyam pa ched thad du gsal btab nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/zhes brjod cing bla ma dkon mchog gi yon tan dran pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pas dkon mchog la blo lings kyis bkal nas skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ bla ma dkon mchog rin po che rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ skyabs 'gro'i dge ba bsngo ba yang bya ste/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /ces pa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ dmigs bskor dang po skyabs 'gro'i 'khrid tshar/ de ltar dmigs pa phog rjes/ slob ma rnams zhag gsum sogs ci rigs par skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa skyong du 'jug gzhan yang slob ma nyan par spro/ bla ma 'chad par spro/ slob mas go ru rung*/ slob dpon gyis 'chad shes/ /dgos don gal che ba bshad na go zhing blo chos su 'gyur/ ma bshad na sngar ma go bas blo sna chos la mi 'gyur ba sogs/ nges par bshad dgos pa'i rigs yin na/ slob ma rnams dmigs pa skyong ba'i skabs su/ nyin re bzhin mdo dang sngags sam/ theg pa che chung gi skyabs 'gro'i go don rnams blo la 'byor nges par rim gyis bshad do/ /'di skabs nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs yul rnams ma bsdus par bla ma'i sku'i mdun gyi phyogs kyi sa gzhi la pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid nyal bar mos te/ skyabs yul la mos gus sgom bzhin pas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /zhar byung gi man ngag go /gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sngar bzhin las/ lan mang nyung ran tsam byas te/ skyabs yul rang la bstim pa'i rjes su/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams la blos gzhig 'brel zhig btang la/ phyogs bcu ga la phyin kyang nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams la mtha' med/

'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rigs drug gi sems can gyis go mtshams med par khyab/ sems can de thams cad drin can gyi pha ma yin/ de thams cad 'dod ni bde ba 'dod kyang*/ bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs la ni mi mkhas pas/ sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la spyod pa snying re rje/ de rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las drangs/ thar pa rnams kyi mchog bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la myur du 'god par bya/ da lta de'i nus pa bdag la med pas nus pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod cing don bsam pa ci nus su bya/ thun 'jog khar dge ba bsngo ba skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin no/ /dmigs bskor gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi 'khrid tshar/ 'dir yang spro zhing dgos na/ zhag gsum sogs sems bskyed bsgom pa'i ring la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi don zhib mor bshad par bya'o/ / gsum pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sems bskyed kyi skabs ltar las/ de rnams dmigs pa gsal zhing 'jur la yun thung ba re byas nas/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa'i de ma thag tu/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje bsnyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang padma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pa lā ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa| u nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shre yaṃ/ ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ skabs 'dir dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang*/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun//

sogs gong bzhin/ dmigs bskor gsum pa yi ge brgya pa'i 'khrid tshar/ 'di la long skabs yod cing nus na/ zla ba gcig gnyis su bsgom bzlas byed du gzhug dgos/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags byung byung du sgom dgos pa yin/ de la rtags ni nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ khrus byas pa dang/ chu bo chen po las brgal ba dang*/ 'khru skyugs dang*/ lus las rnag khrag zag pa la sogs pa nyams kyi tshul du byung ba'am/ rmi lam shin du gsal ba lan mang du byung na yin/ gzhan yang 'di bsgom pas dngos su sngar las rig pa dwangs pa dang*/ dmigs pa gsal ba dang*/ lus yang ba dang*/ dad pa dang snying rje nges 'byung sogs cher song ba dang*/ gnyid rmugs le lo chags sdang sogs chung du song bar mngon na sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags mchog yin no/ /yang mgyogs khrid kyi skabs zhag gnyis gsum sogs las byed long ma byung na/ 'khrid grol gyi bar la/ thun mgo la 'di ma chag par rtag tu sgom dgos so/ /'dir yang spro zhing dgos na/ sdig pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ bshags bsdam byed tshul dang*/ bsgom bzlas kyi go don rnams kyang zhib mor bshad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ skyabs sems gong bzhin sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams skyabs yul gyi skabs ltar yid kyis gsal btab/ de nas phyag 'tshal/ skyabs 'gro/ maṇḍal rnams bya ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /ces pa'am/ gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi/ /de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom nas/ /mig skyon med rnams rol par bcas pas steng du ni/ /lta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyag bya/ khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang yang*/

khyod ni mgon po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdig 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa yang*/ khyod ni 'ba' zhig gnas dang khyod ni yon tan mchog gi gnas te skyon rnams bcom pa khyod nyid do/ khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pas skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas lus kyi las su maṇḍal gyi tshom bu bkod/ yid kyi dmigs pa 'og gzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la rten pa'i gling bzhi ri rab 'khor yug dang bcas pa/ steng phyogs srid pa'i rtse mo man chad khams gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa lha dang mi'i dngos po bzang la gya nom pas go mtshams med cing phyur bur bkang ste/ bla ma dkon mchog rnams la phul/ de'i rjes su bdag myur du sangs rgyas thob pa dang*/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams rtogs skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ de dag gi skabs ngag tu 'di skad ces/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūṃ/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badzra re khāe āḥhūṃ/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gi bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba lang spyod/ sgra gcan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dus me/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/

/rin chen maṇḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ /blo yis dmigs nas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa'am/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces brjod/ tshul des maṇḍal ci nus su 'bul/ thun 'jog khar/ mchod yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dge ba bsngo ba gong skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin bya/ dmigs bskor bzhi pa maṇḍal gyi 'khrid tshar/ 'di yang 'khrid kyi dngos gzhi'i nyams rtogs skye ba'i rgyu gsar du tshogs bsag thub pa'i rtags byung byung du byed dgos pas zla ba la sogs par skyong dgos/ rtags ni seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa dang*/ con pan 'ching ba dang*/ chas gos bzang po dang*/ skye bo mang pos rang la phyag 'tshal ba sogs nyams dang rmi lam du byung na yin/ dngos kyi rtags ni sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags dang 'dra/ mgyogs 'khrid la zhag gsum sogs las byed long ma byung na/ 'khrid rdzogs kyi bar du thun mgo la 'di yang byed dgos la/ skabs 'dir yang spro zhing dgos na/ maṇḍal gyi phan yon dang*/ dus 'khor rang lugs kyi 'jig rten khams kyi bkod pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs sgo du ma nas bsag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams zhib mor bshad do/ /lnga pa ni/ skyabs sems sngar bzhin/ gnas khang dag pa'i zhing du gsal ba'i dbus su/ seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/

rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa| 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'i sku can/ mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan rang*/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ spros pa la dga' na phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ bsdu na yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa blos phul te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /sdig pa bshags so/ /dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /bla na med pa'i lam bsten par bgyi'o/ /bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod cing don bsam/ bar 'dir spro na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i gsol 'debs logs na yod pa rnams bya zhing*/ bsdus pa la dga' na ma byas kyang choganges par gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo chos rje dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma= skyabs mchog mtshungs med= 'dren mchog mtshungs med= thar ba'i lam ston= dngos grub 'byung gnas= ma rig mun sel bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag rtse gcig sgrub pa nus par= sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar= sgrub pa snying po nyams su longs par= sgrub pa rab kyi mthar phyin par= byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs par= zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob par= nyams myong dang rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar= zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa mthar phyin par=

phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma'i sku'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥrnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor zhugs/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral par thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ hūṃ las 'od zer mthing nag 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dgashes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ hoḥlas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rang gi lte bar thim/ chags rtog gi bag chags dag / bzhi pa ye shes rdo rje'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ slar yang mos gus dung ba dang yid kyi gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa rnams bla ma nyid la thim/ de nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'od zer ram bdud rtsi'i tshul du zhu ste rang la thim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de lta bu bskyar 'debs byed kyin ci nus su bsgoms/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba gong dang 'dra/ gzhan yang*/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ zhes sogs ci rigs pa'ang brjod/ dmigs bskor lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid tshar/ sngags lam gyi nyams rtogs thams cad bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi sgo nas lam du byed dgos pas/ 'di yang lo dang zla bar sgom dgos/ mgyogs khrid kyi skabs zhag gnyis gsum tsam las sgom long ma byung na/ 'di yang 'khrid yongs rdzogs ma tshar gyi bar du thun mgor ma chag pa sgom pa gal che/ skabs 'di dag tu'ang spro zhing dgos na/ bla ma'i mos gus lam du byed dgos tshul/

mos gus kyi phan yon/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ bla ma bsten tshul sogs zhib du bshad do/ /dmigs pa 'di'i yan lag nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba la bla ma sku tshad tshon gang tsam dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal du bzhugs pa la mos gus dung nge ba'i ngang las gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi nyer bsdogs khyad par can dben pa gsum bsten pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bskyed rim la gtso bor byed pa'i skabs yin na| sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ lha lnga'am lha dgu ma'i bar du rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa yod pa bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi tshang ba'i tshul gyis bsgom pa yin yang*/ 'dir rdzogs rim gtso bor byed pa'i skabs yin pas/ gtso bo yab yum tsam gyi lha'i rnal 'byor bsdus pas chog cing*/ de las kyang lhag par bsdus pa lhan skyes nyid bsngags pas/ de'i sgom tshul ni/ skyabs sems sngar bzhin bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab pad zla nyi ma sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas dbang phyug dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying gar mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag sor rnams kha dog lnga pa dang*/ sor tshigs rnams kha dog gsum pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan zhing*/ me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can no/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing*/ dbu skra phyed grol ba'o/ /dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gsang gnas su swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ lha sku gsal stong de la ci nus su mnyam par gzhagade ltar yang yang bsgoms kyang legs/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ lha sku 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du sbyang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/dus kyi 'khor lo sogs dang*/ gong bzhin dge ba bsngo/ 'di 'khrid kyi skabs yin pas lha sku la sems 'dzin pa ma gtogs bzlas pa byed mi dgos/ 'on kyang cung zad sngags bzla bar spro na/ bzlas kyang mi 'gal bas lha sku stong nyid du bsdu ba'i sngon du/ oṃ

swāhā/ zhes pa nyid ci rigs par bzla ba yin/ 'di la ye shes dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab rgyas pa'i srol yang gda' ba/ de ltar byas na rgyas pa'i lugs su 'gyur bas shin tu rung mod/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung las 'di tsam las ma bshad cing*/ lhan skyes kyi phyogs la 'di kho nas go chod pas/ 'jug pa bde ba 'di legs so/ /bla ma gong ma 'ga' res yi dam kun gyi smar 'khrid kyi man ngag 'di la sbyar ba yang yod do/ /dmigs skor drug pa bskyed rim gyi 'khrid tshar/ bskyed rim gyi go don rgyas pa skabs 'dir bshad kyi mi lang zhing logs su yod pas 'dir mi 'chad/ spro zhing dgos na lhan skyes sgrub thabs kyi go don zhib tu bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ bar 'dir rdzogs rim gyi ye shes ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i don du/ mchog dbang gong ma bla ma'i man ngag dang ldan pa bskur dgos te/ de'i yi ge logs su yod pa ltar yin la/ de yang dben gsum gyi/ rjes so sor sdud pa'i sngon du byed pa thob thang gi dus skabs yin yang deng sang de lag len mi bde bas skabs 'dir byed pa'i lag len gtso che'o/ /de nas 'khrid 'bogs pa ni/ rgyud las/ bdud rtsi lnga la <bdud rtsi lnga ste gzugs phung la sogs pa phung po lnga la ltos pa med pa dang*/ sogs sgras bstan pa'i dbang po lnga la ltos pa med pa dang*/ chu gter zhes pa bzhi'i ming ste/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid dang*/ 'pho ba'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang ltos med drug rgyud las bstan pa des dngos gzhi rdo rje bzhi smin par byed dgos/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su lha 'grub pa'i ched du sngags kyi bzlas pa dang tshogs dang gtor ma 'bul ba sogs kyis bsgrub pa'i don du rdzogs rim gyi skabs su rlung las rung du gyur pa'i ched du 'byung 'jug gi rlung rags pa sbyong ba rnams dgos3gt; sogs dang chu gter rdo rje rnams dang sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs kyis bsnyen pa ste/

/zhes gsungs pa'i don 'grel par ltos med bzhi ldan du gsungs shing*/ gsang 'dus las kyang*/ lus ngag sems rnams sgom pa ni/ rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pa/ /gang na'ang mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer sgom/ /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag ste/ ltos med bzhi ldan nam/ dben pa gsum ldan zhes bya'o/ /de yang lus kyi longs spyod dang*/ bde sdug sogs gang la'ang chags sdang spangs shing*/ ji snyam pa mi byed la/ dgag sgrub blang dor gyi rtog pa spangs pa ni/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa zhes bya ba yin/ de bzhin du ngag dang*/ yid dang*/ 'pho ba'i longs spyod la'ang sbyar bas/ ltos med bzhi ldan gyi gdams pa zhes bya la/ sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lus ngag yid gsum bya byed kho na la 'das kyang don med dang don log par song nas/ yang dag pa'i 'bras bu gang yang ma grub/ da phyin chad byar med du bzhag na/ grub pa dang bde ba bla na med pa thob nges pas/ nang gi khams 'khrug pa sogs gegs dang gol sa spang ba'i phyir du/ lus gnad bca' zhing*/ rlung ro bsal ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i don la sems gnas pa'i phyir dran pa bsten tsam ma gtogs/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan lta ci smos/ ting nge 'dzin 'di la brtan pa cung zad ma thob kyi bar du dge las kyi spros pa yang phal cher bskyungs nas/ lus bya byed kyis dben pa/ ngag smrar brjod kyis dben pa/ sems rnam rtog gis dben pa gcig rnams dgos pas/ dben pa gsum bsten pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de la 'di skabs su/ mun khang dang blta stangs nges pa can la sogs pa mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ma yin yang*/ dngos gzhi sor sdud la myur du 'jug dgos pas de'i lam byang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mun khang dang blta stangs nges pa can yang phyag len la mdzad par gda'/ des na 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/

gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing*/ /gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams/ / bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa/ /der ni rnal 'byor yang dag brtsams/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yul phyogs dang*/ yang mdo sde rgyan las/ /blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang*/ /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ las dang po yi gang zag gis/ /lus <bya byed ngag smra brjod kyis > dben pa la ma brten par/ /sems <rnam rtog gis > dben rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ / <chags sdang gi rnam rtog skye ba'i rgyu rang yul sogs dang > 'dres spangs dben par gnas par bya/ / <yul mi sogs dang > 'dres pas 'dris shing chags par byed/ /de yis 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor/ /de bas 'dres pa spang pa la/ /rtag tu bag dang ldan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ nyin mo skye bo'i rgyu 'grul med pa/ mtshan mo sgra'i brlag cor med pa/ 'tshe ba'i 'j-igs pa med cing*/ 'thung rgyu'i chu lus la mi gnod pa cig dgos/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gnas kyi khyad par 'byor ldan yin na/ steng khang ngam bar khang mun khang sgo 'khyog rim pa gsum pa/ skar khung phyi chung la nang yangs pa/ phye na mthong dkar zhing*/ de 'bo rdo sogs kyis bkag na snang ba rta rnga tsam yang mi 'byung ba zhig dgos pa yin la/ kun spangs kyi gnas ni/ sa phug dang*/ brag phug dang*/ khyim la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa ste/ 'on kyang skam zhing sa rlangs med pa/ mun pa shin tu gnag pa zhig dgos la/ de ltar yod na gang du'ang rung ngo*/ /gnas der sngon 'gro sgom pa'i tshul ni/ thun dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bskyed rim rnams lus gnad ci bde ba'i ngang nas bya/ thun phyi ma rnams la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsdus pa dang*/ bla ma la mos gus dung tsam byas pas chogasngar bsags sbyang gi 'khrid gnyis la nyams myong ma skyes na/

thun dang po la yig brgya dang maṇḍal yang byed dgos pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed grub ma thag rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang*/ de'i rgyun la maṇḍal dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang/ shū n+ya tas stong par sbyangs pa nas/ sems 'dzin pa'i bar gyis bskyed rim kyang byed/ de'i nang nas kyang cung zad rgyas pa la spro na sngar bshad pa bzhin dang*/ bsdu na skyabs 'gro'i skabs skyabs yul rang la ma bstim par mdun du bzhugs su gsol ba la/ maṇḍal gyi skabs su maṇḍal 'bul ba dang*/ de kha la gsol 'debs man chad kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams byas pas zor yang zhing gnad la 'byor bar 'ong*/ thun gyi sngon 'gro nyams su len lugs dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir ma zad/ 'di man chad dngos gzhi'i skabs sogs thams cad du 'dra ba yin no/ /dben gsum gyi nyams len dngos ni/ mun khang der bsam gtan 'bol chung btings nas/ lus gnad rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ sgal tshigs dang ltag pa bsrang*/ lkog mas ol mdud non tsam gyis mgrin pa dgugaso mchu rang sar bzhag lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig gi lta stangs dang lag pa ni skabs 'dir ji ltar bde ba yin mod kyang*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs lag pa khu tshur brla bzhag dgos pas de 'byongs pa'i phyir 'dir yang bya ste/ mthe bos srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan pa la sor mo rnams kyis phyi nas bsdams pa'i khu tshur gyis brla'i rtsa bar mnan la lag ngar bsrang*/ mig kyang dngos gzhi dang phyogs mtshungs par steng phyogs kyi nam mkha' la blta ba'i tshul gyis gyen du bsgril nas 'byed 'dzum sogs mi byed par g.yo med du bzhag /de ltar lus gnad bcas ma thag tu sngar rlung 'khrugs pa dang 'khyams pa sel zhing phyis rlung skyon mi 'byung ba'i phyir rlung ro lan gsum sna sgo nas sangs kyis 'bud/ de rjes nas thun grol gyi bar du rlung rang babs su bzhag ci bder rgyu ru gzhugasems kyi gnad gang yang bsam du med pa/

ci yang yid la mi byed pa/ ched du ma sgrim/ ched du ma klod/ phar nam mkha' sogs la cher gyis blta ba yang ma yin/ tshur rang nyid la ched du lta ba yang ma yin/ gang la yang mi brten/ cir yang 'char rung tsam de la bzo bcos med pa lhod de bzhag de kha la gnas shing sgom tu btub na legs/ gal te sems 'phro na de'i gnyen po brten dgos/ de la 'phro lugs gnyis te/ sems gnas 'phro la rnam rtog thol thol skye zhing gzugs sogs yul kyi rnam pa yid la wal wal 'char la/ shar ma thag tu sems 'phros pa rang gi shes kyin 'dug na/ de la dga' mi dga' dang rtog dpyod gang yang mi bya bar de nyid 'phro rbad kyis bcad nas/ sems 'jog tshul sngar gyi de kha bskyangs pas chog yang rnam rtog gcig la gcig brgyud pa sna tshogs pa 'phro zhing*/ yun ring por 'byams 'gro na skyon che ste/ 'on kyang 'di la nam dran pas zin ma thag tu/ da phyin chad 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams su 'gro ba 'di ma byung ba byed dgos/ nam 'phro ba na dran pas zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po skabs skabs su btang/ gang yang bsam du med pa'i ngang nas rig pa khong sgrim/ sems gnas sam mi gnas/ 'phro'am mi 'phro snyam pa'i dran shes kyi bya ra yang yang btang bas/ 'og 'gyu rgyu 'byams kyi song ba de je chung je chung la sogs pa/ mi ring ba na sangs te 'gro/ de ltar rtse gcig tu 'jur la sgom zhing*/ thun 'jog khar dge ba bsngo ba gong dang 'dra/ thun mtshams su'ang sems bzo med kyi gdangs dang ma bral ba bya zhing*/ gtam cal col mi smra/ sku mnye dang kha zas kyi lcag gis bskul/ 'di ltar bsgoms pas lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams/ mthong nyams/ rmi nyams sogs gang byung kyang*/ nyams gyi sne mi bskyil mi bkag par rang babs la gang byung de ka byung rgyal lhug par bskyang dgos/ <dbang mdor bstan > ji skad du/ gang la'ang skyon du mi blta zhing*/

/ci yang ma yin nyams su blangs/ /drod rtags la sogs 'dod mi bya/ /sgom du med par bstan mod kyang*/ /le lo btang snyoms dbang mi btang*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ thun thun mtshams thams cad du bzang du re ba dang*/ skyon gyis dogs pa mi bya/ spyod lam drag shul dang*/ 'dod yon la dga' ba sogs kyi rnam rtog spangs/ kun da byang chub kyi sems ma nyams par bsrung*/ gos sogs grang dro ran pa dang*/ mtshan mo'i gnyid tshim par log nyin mo'i gnyid spangs thun gyi skabs rtse gcig tu shugs phyung la sgom zhing*/ thun yun bsring ba legs so/ /dmigs bskor bdun pa dben gsum gyi 'khrid tshar/ 'di skabs zhag gnyis gsum sgom du bcug cing*/ de bar la spro zhing dgos na/ dben pa'i phan yon dang*/ zhi lhag gi rang bzhin/ dben gsum gyi gnad rnams zhib mor bshad/ de ltar legs por nges su bcug nas/ lag len bslab/ byin brlabs bya/ lag len/ sbros pa la dga' na/ byin rlabs 'bebs shing gtor dbang yang bskur te/ de'i tshul ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyis logs su yi ge mdzad pa ltar shes par bya'o/ de rjes nas mun 'khrid kyi mtshams la 'jug 'khrid lta yang yang bya zhing*/ gnad du ma 'byor ba rnams bcos/ gegs sel ba dang ngo sprod pa sogs skabs su gang bab bya'o/ /de dag gis ni zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro'i 'khrid rnams tshar ba yin no// gnyis pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi dngos gzhi sgom pa'i rim pa ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang*/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*/ srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*/ /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod/ ces gsungs shing*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang*/ /bde bas kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ <zhes yan lag drug gi nang tshan gyi 'bras bu gsum bstan pas rgyu sor stud sogs kyang bstan to/>

/zhes dang*/ dgyes rdor las kyang*/ yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor pas/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs te/ mdor na yan lag drug ni/ sor sdud kyi yan lag bsam gtan/ srog rtsol/ 'dzin pa/ rjes dran/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste drug po de yin la/ de dag rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang du byas na/ sor bsam sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ srog 'dzin gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ rjes dran thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ ting nge 'dzin ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ro/ /bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ltar na/ <sor bsam gnyis mthar thug zung 'jug ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa'i rgyu stong gzugs mngon du gyur zhing snang sems dbyer med du snang ba'i rnal 'byor yin pas de gnyis zung 'jug mchog gi sku 'grub pa la thog mar nye lam yin phyir nyer sgrub dang*/ srog 'dzin gnyis ma dag pa'i rlung bkags nas rlung thig dbyer med du byed pa'i rnal 'byor yin pas de gnyis sngar las ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa la lhag par nye phyir nyer sgrub dang*/ rjes dran ni 'bar snang gi lha sku 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor yin pas sgrub pa dang*/ ting 'dzin mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa yin pas sgrub chen no/> sor bsam bsnyen pa/ srog 'dzin nyer sgrub/ rjes dran sgrub pa/ ting nge 'dzin sgrub chen no/ /dge ba gsum ltar na/ sor bsam thog mar dge ba/ srog 'dzin bar du dge ba/ dran ting tha mar dge ba'o/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis ltar na/ sor sdud srog rtsol rjes dran gsum rgyu'i yan lag bsam gtan 'dzin pa ting nge 'dzin gsum 'bras bu'i yan lag go /thams cad kyang phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor du gcig la/ yan lag dngos rnams ni snga ma snga ma mthar phyin nas phyi ma phyi ma rgyud la skye bas thog mar skye ba'i dus skabs rim can du gnas shing*/

de dag skye ba'i rgyu tshogs la bslab pa yan lag drug rjes mthun pa ni/ thog mar so sor zhus shing sbyang nas/ de rjes stan thog gcig tu rdzogs par nyams su len no/ /des na skabs 'dir dngos gzhi la/ thog mar dge ba'i 'khrid/ bar du dge ba'i 'khrid/ tha mar dge ba'i 'khrid de gsum las/ dang po la/ so sor sdud pa'i 'khrid dang*/ bsam gtan gyi 'khrid do/ /dang po ni/ gong ma mang po dag dus zhabs snyan brgyud las/ kun la'ang drug tu shes bya ste/ /zhes pa'i go don du mdzad nas/ yan lag thams cad la sa bcad drug gis 'chad par gda'/ sa bcad ni bshad pa yin pas ji ltar sbyar kyang rung mod/ skabs 'dir gong ma'i gsung las kyang mi 'da' zhing*/ go bde bar sbyar na 'di ltar legs te/ so sor sdud pa'i 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang*/ sgom don blo la 'god pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ sor sdud dngos dang*/ bogs 'don spogs pa'i cho ga gnyis so/ /dang po sor sdud dngos la/ mtshan mo gseng med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ nyin mo sprin med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ <mun pa'i > nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i <zhen pa ste mngon sum du mthong ba'i sems g.yo med du byas te3gt;

sems dang mig ni <mig 'byed 'dzum mi byed par gyen du bltas te rdo rje'i lam zhes pa dbu mar zhugs par byas te bsgoms > mi 'dzum rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yis/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngon 'gro sngar bzhin btang*/ gnas khang skabs 'dir nges par mun khang kho na yin zhing*/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nges par dgos te/ dri med 'od las/ bla ma'i <rtogs pa'am > nges pa'i <gdams ngag gi > dbang gis sgom pa'i dus dang*/ 'dod pa'i <lhag pa'i > lha la bstod pa'i dus <kyi > su grangs bzhin du sangs rgyas <pa'i tshe > pa rnams la rdo rje'i <skyil krung gi gdan3gt; gdan bsngags shing*/ zhes gsungs/ lag pa'ang mnyam bzhag gam khu tshur brla bzhag gang rung zhig dgos par gsungs pas gzhan mi bya/ lta stangs ni rgyud las/ bsnyen pa <sor bsam gnyis > la ni dang po'i rnal 'byor rnam <sa bcu > bcu mkha' la <gtsug tor > 'khor lo can gyi khro bo'i lta bas so/ / zhes 'byung bas/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lta stangs zhes bya ba/ smin mtshams nas sor bcu drug gzhal ba'i steng gi nam mkha' la lta ba 'di kho na dgos/ de yang dbang mdor bstan las/ bkab dang ma bkab mig dag gis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mig ha cang gdangs pa ma yin pa/ ha cing btsum pa ma yin pa rang babs kyi ngang nas mig 'bras gyen la bzlog pa yin/ dmigs gsal can rnams ma gtogs/ sor bsam gnyis kyi skabs thams cad lus gnad lta stangs 'di kho nar nges so/ /de ltar lus gnad byas nas/ bya ba gzhan spangs te bzhag pas rtsa rnams g.yo med du gnas pa ni lus mi g.yo ba/ ngag gnad dben gsum gyi skabs bzhin byas pas dag mi g.yo ba/ sems kyi gnad kyang phal cher dben gsum dang 'dra ba las/ gang du mig lta sa'i thad nam mkha'i mun pa la sems che re gtad nas 'jog pa yin te/ dri med 'od las/ dang por stong nyid byang chub ni mun pa la ci yang bsam par mi bya'o/

/ zhes gsungs te/ yid mi g.yo ba'o/ /de ltar na/ grub thob shā wa ri pa'i zhal nas/ mi g.yo ba ni gsum ldan gyis/ /dhū tīr rlung bcu chud gyur pas/ /phyi nang rtog 'gags rtags bcu 'byung*/ /so sor gcod pa'i yan lag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don tshang bar bya zhing*/ dpal sa ra has kyang*/ mang du smras pas ci zhig bya/ /chos kyi tshad ni 'di yis chog /mig phyed gyen du lta ba na/ /mthong ba brtan pa nyid kyis shes/ /zhes dang*/ bar snang la ni yid dang rlung dang mig /dus gcig tu ni gal te nges sbyar na/ /rin chen rgyal ba'i yon tan nges par skye/ /'di dag mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ lta stangs nges par gyen du blta dgos pa yang*/ 'grel chen las/ mig mi 'dzum par steng du blta bas mtshan mar 'gyur ba yin te/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na| lus gnad byed bcing dang ldan pas yid mig rlung gsum gtsug tor thad kyi nam mkha' dang dbyer med du bsres te gang yang yid la mi byed par sgom dgos so/ /sor sdud kyi dmigs pa dngos te/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa dang po'o/ /yang paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i man ngag las/ dmigs pa gtong tshul mi 'dra tsam bzhi byung ba'i man ngag ni 'di yin te/ sor sdud kyi dmigs pa'i rtsa ba sngar bshad pa de nyid bsam med kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ dpe lha khang nang gi lder bzo lta bu zer/ de skabs sems ma gzhur ba'i skyon gyis rtog pa 'phro ba'am/ sgom skyon can thebs te/ shes pa lteng por song nas sgom min gnyid min du 'gro na/ lta stangs kyi lam nas drangs te/ nam mkha'i dbus su sems thim 'gro ba lta bu shes pa drag tu gtad/ rig pa hur phyung ste bsgrims nas sgom pa ni/ rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ste/ spre'u sgo gcig tu btags pa lta bu'o/ /dmigs bskor gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas rlung stod du 'tshang ba dang*/

mig rus na ba dang*/ ye shes phebs pa ma yin par brgyal ba dang*/ zug gzer skye ba sogs byung na/ byed bcing sngar las ma g.yos bzhin du sems gsal rig gi steng du che re bzo bcos med par bzhag cing*/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi rnam par rtogs pa spangs te/ da ltar ba'i shes pa so ma la rang ngo shes pa'i dran pa bsten pa ni/ rang grol kyi rnal 'byor te/ dpe spun gsum gyi bar ma dang 'grogs pa zhes bya ste/ dmigs bskor gsum pa'o/ /dmigs pa de gnyis kyi skabs su/ sems bsgrims pas yud tsam re gnas shing*/ de'i 'phro la ji tsam sgrim gyin 'phro rgod du song na/ ha cang grim drag pa'i skyon yin pas/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa'i bya ra tsam bzhag nas/ gang yang mi sgom par lhod gyis klod do/ /'di ni rtsol bral gyi rnal 'byor te/ dpe rnga mo btags grol lta bu'o/ /dmigs bskor bzhi pa'o/ /dmigs pa phyi ma gsum po 'di rnams kyang dang po'i steng du tshang bar bya ste/ /res 'ga' sgrim/ res 'ga' klod/ res 'ga' sems gsal rig gi ngo bo la lta/ phal cher rtsol bral bzo med du 'jog pa nyid mthil du byas te sgom mo/ /dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa dang po phog pa'i mtshams sam/ skabs 'di gnyis gang 'os shig tu dngos gzhi'i mun 'khrid dam po la 'jug par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor yin te/ de la gnas kyi khyad par ni/ 'byor ldan gyi gnas phyed g.yab kha shar bstan dang nub bstan lta bu yin la/ kun spangs kyi gnas ni/ skyo ra'am/ brag dang shing la sogs pas rang gi lus la grib ma 'byung zhing*/ skye bo gzhan gyis tshur mi mthong ba zhig dgos la/ gnyis ka la yang mtshungs par nam mkha' rgya chen po mthong ba'i sar sgom dgos pa yin no/ /mig lam na mar chu 'bab pa dang*/ mtsho rdzing lteng ka sogs mthong sar mi sgom zhes bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig bzhed cing*/

nub byang la mi lta zhes kyang kha cig 'dod la nyi 'od dang*/ gangs ri sogs 'od 'tsher bas mig la gnod pas/ de dag kyang mig lam du mi 'byung bas sa'o/ /dus ni/ snga dro nyi mar rgyab phyogs te/ /phyi dro yang ni de bzhin no/ /nyi phyed mig la gnod pas spangs/ /zhes pa ltar/ snga dro kha nub tu phyogs/ phyi dro kha shar du phyogs pas sgom zhing*/ phyed g.yab byang bstan nam/ brag dang rtsig pa la sogs pa'i grib ma che bar yod na/ nyin gung yang byang du phyogs pas sgom du rung*/ de dag kyang sprin ser bu la sogs pa med pa'i dus su sgom zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ srod tho rangs nyin gung rnams dang*/ gzhan yang sprin dang rlung po yod pa'i dus nyin mo'i rnal 'byor mi sgom ste/ mun khang du mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor nyid sgom par byas la/ gnas dus sogs mthun rkyen 'dzom na 'di nyid sgom pa yin no/ / bsgom bya dngos ni gong du bstan pa'i mi g.yo gsum ldan de nyid yin la/ rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor sogs gnad phyi ma gsum po de'ang gegs sel bogs 'don du dgos pa byung na bsgoms pas/ bsgom bya dngos nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis po gcig pa yin la/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ rgyud las/ nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal 'byor pa yi bgrad pa'i mig gis lta bar bya ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pas nyin mo'i rnal 'byor bstan te/ lta stangs kyi gnad khro bo'i lta ba sdang mig 'bru tshugs su lta tshul dgos pa yin/ de bzhin du dmigs pa'i yul gyi gnad kyang mun nag gi nam mkha' la lta ba'i tshab tu/ sprin med kyi nam mkha' sngo sang nge ba dang*/ rang sems gsal hrig ge ba dbyer med pa lta bu la 'jog go /dngos gzhi'i dmigs bskor drug pa'o/ /gnyis pa bogs 'don spogs chog la/ nyin par dang 'brel ba'i spogs chog dang*/ mtshan mo gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni/

de la spyir yan lag drug gar gyi spogs chog btsan thabs sbyor ba rnam pa gsum yin par rgyud las gsungs/ de dag rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'dir dang po'i las can la sor sdud kho na dang 'brel ba ni/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ so sor sdud pa'i spogs pa ni/ /byed bcing drag tu brtsam par bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ byed bcing gang la zer na/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba las/ mtshan mo gseng med khyim du ni/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag sgrub pa pos/ / byed pa lnga la bcing pa gnyis/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas/ 'di yang rgyud las gsungs pa'i spogs chog btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba'i nang du gtogs pa yin no/ /de yang byed pa lnga ni dbang po lnga'i rlung*/ bcing pa gnyis ni srog dang thur sel bcing pa yin pas/ 'di'i lag len ni nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gang gi skabs yin yang 'dra/ mig gnyis lta sa rgya chen po ma yin pa phra mo gcig la drag tu bsgril/ lce phugs su bzlog mchu dang sna dang rna ba gsum gcud/ bzhin khro bo'i gdong du bya/ lus nya bzhi sgrim zhing rkang sor rnams bkug khu tshur dang skyil krung dam du bya/ dpung pa drag tu rgyangs/ des dbang po lnga'i rlung 'ching*/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba dang*/ phyir 'phel kha bskyed pa gnyis re mos bya/ de yang re mos myur po ma yin par chu tshod re re tsam spel dgos/ des srog thur gnyis bcings par 'gyur/ de lta bu thun gyi gsum cha'am/ bzhi cha tsam re bsgom/ thun gyi lhag ma rnams dkyus bzhin sgom pas/ sor sdud yun ring du bsgoms kyang nyams rtogs ma skyes pa rnams skye/ dang po cung zad skyes kyang nyams pa rnams gso thub/ sngar cung zad skyes pa ma nyams kyang dang po skyes pa de las yar bskyed ma byung na'ang*/ 'di bsgoms pas gong 'phel du 'gro/ des na spogs pa'i cho ga zhes bya'o/ /thog ma nyid nas 'di bsgoms kyang tshegs che zhing gegs sdang la/

phyis bogs bskyed chung bar yod pas/ gong gi gnas skabs gsum po de byung na sgom gyi gzhan mi dgos so/ /dmigs bskor bdun pa'o/ /yang tsa mi dang*/ rga lo'i man ngag las/ skar khung la lta ba dang*/ snod chus gang ba la lta ba'i man ngag re yod kyang stong gzugs kyi spogs chog tu cung zad 'gro mod kyi/ gnad gal chung bar mngon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i skabs sor sdud kyi lus gnad ma 'byongs bar du ni/ rang babs su bzhag pa nyid legs la/ lus gnad lta ltangs 'byongs nas/ tsog pu'am/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu bcug pa seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal zhing*/ mig btsum nas mig 'bras gyen la bzlog pa'i lta stangs dang*/ sems kyi gnad lta stangs kyi lam nas drangs te nam mkha' la lta ba nyid yin pas/ de'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /nyin mo'i sgom shugs dang*/ gnyid du 'gro khar mtshams sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis/ zhag bdun nam/ zla ba phyed dam/ zla ba gcig la sogs pa nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin par 'gyur/ ci ste ma zin na/ rang dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang 'od du zhu/ 'od phung gi mtha' nas rim gyis yal/ snying kha'i thad du til 'bru tsam mam spu shad tsam la ring du sems bzung*/ de yang yal te nam mkha' stong pa la sems gtad/ de lta bu lan bdun tsam bsgoms nas sngar bzhin byas pas myur du zin par 'gyur ro/ /de la gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i tshad mang po yod kyang*/ re zhig gnyid 'thug po'i skabs su gsal stong gi rig pa rnam rtog gi g.ya' dang bral zhing*/ rang ngo skyong shes pa la rtags snang sna tshogs pa 'char ba zhig byung na gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i grangs su chud pa yin no/ /dmigs bskor brgyad pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa ni/ gang zag shin tu blo dman pa bshad kyang mi go ba dang*/

blo gros chen po'i rigs bshad mi dgos pa dang*/ mgyogs khrid byed pa'i skabs rnams su ma bshad kyang chog gnas skabs gzhan du ci rigs par 'chad pa bla ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi rgyun yin zhing*/ gal yang che ba yin te 'og ma rnams la'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /de yang mdo tsam smos na/ so sor sdud pa'i mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag bsgom pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug go /dang po ni/ legs par sbyar ba saṃskṛta'i skad du/ pra ti so so/ ā ha ra skabs thobs kyis sdud pa/ spong ba/ za ba/ gcod pa/ len pa sogs la 'jug pa las/ skabs 'dir sdud pa ste/ mtshams sbyar bas pra tyā ha ra so sor sdud pa'o/ /tha mal pa'i dbang po lnga dang yul lnga'i 'brel ba gcod cing yul la rnam shes yan pa sdud pa dang*/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi dbang po gzhan lnga 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin gyi yul lnga la longs spyod cing za ba dang len pa'i don yin te/ mdor na tha mal gyi snang ba la sems bsdus nas ye shes kyi snang ba la 'jug pa'i don no/ /de ltar yang*/ rgyud las/ so sor sdud pa lus la yul dang yul can bcu po rnams ni rab tu 'jug pa med pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sor sdud thog ma rang bsgom pa'i skabs kyi lan gcig po de la/ rlung sna bug g.yon nas g.yas su 'phos ma thag pas rlung 'bab pa'i dus der bsgoms na/ g.yas kyi 'pho ba rnams 'byung pa sdud rim gyi rgyu ba yin pas ma dag pa'i snang ba dbyings su bsdu ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can du 'gyur/ gzhan yang las dang po pas gnyid kyi dus ma gtogs 'bad nas sgom pa gal che zhing*/ lus gnad 'byongs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams ci rigs pa brtan nas nyin gung dang*/ phyi phred kyi dus thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor tsam gyi sgo nas bskyangs na gegs mi sdang zhing bogs che ba yin no gsungs so*/

/gsum pa ni/ sor sdud kyi ngo bo ni rnam par mi rtog pa mi g.yo gsum ldan gyis rlung dbu mar sdud pa'i nus pa can zhig ste/ nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten la chags 'jig gnyis/ bcud kyi sems can la skye 'chi gnyis/ lo la bgrod pa <lho bgrod dang byang bgrod > gnyis/ zla ba la phyogs <dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs > gnyis/ zhag la nyin mtshan gnyis/ khams <dkar dmar > 'pho ba la g.yas g.yon gnyis/ dus sbyor dang rlung gi 'pho ba la'ang <g.yas > mnyam pa dang mi <g.yon > mnyam pa gnyis sogs thabs shes kyi dbye ba'i dag pas nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis nges par dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar yang*/ rgyud phyi ma las/ <mtshan mo ste mun pa'i nam mkhar du ba la sogs pa'i mtshan rtags bzhi mngon sum du mthong ba'i mtshan mos rnal 'byor sgom dgos par bstan/> mtshan mo du ba la sogs rnal 'byor slar yang nyin mo nam mkha' la ni <'bar ba la sogs pa'i nyin rtags drug mngon sum du mthong ba'i nyin mo'i rnal 'byor sgom par bstan3gt; 'bar ba la sogs kyang*/ /zhes dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo las kyang*/ ko'u shi ka gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa des nam mkha' la rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /ko'u shi ka gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa des bla gab med pa la rnal 'byor du bslab par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs la nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis tshang ba dgos pa mdo sngags gnyis ka'i dgongs pa yin zhing*/ 'on kyang lus la gnad du bsnun pa sogs thabs khyad par can gzhan gyi sgo nas gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ khyad par du yang 'di'i gnad ni/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyis g.yas kyi dkyil 'khor lnga dang*/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyis g.yon gyi lnga rnams dbu mar bsdus pas mtshan rtags nges pa rtags bcu sogs 'char ba yin te/
gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ so sor sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yul rtags bcu ste/ rgyud las/ stong pa

<rnal 'byor ba'i rang ngo'i stong seng gi nam mkha' > la ni du ba <dang3gt; smig rgyu < dang > rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid <de me khyer dang > /dang mar me dang*/ zhes mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi rtags bzhi dang*/ 'bar ba <ste dus me > dang ni zla ba <dang > / nyi ma <dang > / rdo rje <ste3gt; sgra gcan rnams dang mchog gi cha <ste glog > dang thig le <sngon po > mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi rtags drug ste/ rtags bcu nges pa'i rtags yin la/ bcu po de dag gang rung re'i khongs su gtogs pa yin yang*/ rnam pa ma nges pa'i rtags ni mtha' yas pa zhig go /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan mthong ba zhes bya'o/ /de yang chos nyid don dam pa'i ye shes rang la bzhugs shing*/ lam bsgoms pas de mngon du 'gyur ba la yid ches skye ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir rtags zhes bya yis/ kun rdzob 'khrul snang gi rtags tsam ni ma yin no/ /de ltar rtags de rnams mthong ba'i shes pa ni tshad ma ste/ de yang rgyud las/ lha yi dmigs pa gang yin mngon sum <tshad ma > dang ni rjes su dpag pa <pa'i tshad ma > rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /mngon sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bskyed rim gyi tshad ma ni rjes dpag yin la/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi tshad ma thams cad mngon sum yin no/ /mngon sum yang mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rnam pa <dbang po mngon sum/ yid kyi mngon sum/ rang rig mngon sum/ rnal 'byor mngon sum > bzhi yod la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas <rnal 'byor mngon sum mngon > sum gcig yin pas/ yan lag drug po so so'i skabs kyi mngon sum thams cad la mngon sum bzhi char gyi mtshan nyid cha shas re tshang yod kyang*/ skabs 'dir dbang po'i mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid gtso che ba yin la/ de'i brten dbang po yang spyan lnga <sha'i spyan/

lha'i spyan/ chos kyi spyan/ shes rab kyi spyan/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan > las sha'i mig yin no/ /de ltar yang*/ dri med 'od las/ 'dir dang por <bsam gtan mthar ma phy-in pa yan chad kyi > las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor <ba'i rgyud la mngon shes ma 'grub > pas mngon par shes pa med par sha'i mig gis sna tshogs mthong ngo*/ /zhes so/ /mig gi sgra ni/ akṣa zhes bya ba'i sgra las drangs na/ dbang po thams cad la'ang 'jug pas gzugs kyi rnam cha mthong ba'i rten kho na la mi bzung gis/ stong pa nyid kyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dzin pa mtha' dag la 'jug go /'og ma rnams la'ang 'dis rigs 'gre'o/ /lnga pa ni/ yan lag drug po thams cad kyis dri ma sbyang bar bya ba'i gzhi ni chos nyid bde gshegs snying po kho na yin pas dbye ba med la/ dag bya la dbye na spyir phung khams sum cu so drug yod pa las/ so sor sdud pa'i ngo skal gyi dag bya ye shes kyi phung po la <ye shes kyi khams/ yid dbang*/ sgra'i skye mched mchog gi dbang po dri chu 'dor ba ste ye shes kyi khams pa drug sogs pa ye shes kyi khams pa drug > sogs pa ye shes kyi khams pa drug tshan gcig po de yin la/ dag byed sor sdud la dbye na bcu ste/ rtags bcu rim pas 'char ba'i dbang gis nyams rtogs mtho dman gyi dbye ba bcu yod pas so/ /drug pa ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu bden tshig 'grub pa dang*/ sngags 'bras grub pa ste/ <rgyud las3gt; so sor sdud pas rnal 'byor pa ni <gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga dang*/ de lnga 'dzin pa'i yul can 'jug shes lnga'i 'brel ba 'byung ba'i rgyud rlung 'gags pa yul dang rnam par bral ba > ste bden tshig <sngags rnams kun gyis byin gyis bden tshig 'grub pa'i don no3gt; brlob/ /ces gsungs/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ nam zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i dus na rdo rje sems dpa' la

<sna tshogs yum/ kun tu bzang po/ sgra rdo rje ma/ gnod mdzes rgyal po/ shin tu sngon mo ste lha ye shes khams pa drug > sogs pa lha ye shes khams pa drug tshan gcig gi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar sor sdud kyi sgom don blo la 'god pa 'di bsdu na thun gcig la tshang bar bya/ rgyas pa la spro na thun mang por bshad de/ mtha' chod la nges pa brtan por bya'o/ /des so sor sdud pa'i 'khrid tshar ro/ / de tsam gyis chog shes par byed na/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rjes kyi 'khrid rnams skabs 'dir bshad de/ re zhig 'khrid rdzogs pa'i lugs su byas la/ yang skabs 'di nas bsam gtan gyi 'khrid ston par 'dod na/ sor sdud kyi sgom don blo la 'god pa song ba'i rjes thogs kho nar bsam gtan gyi 'khrid rim gyis 'bogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsam gtan gyi 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang*/ sgom don blo la 'god pa'o/ /dang po la/ bsam gtan dngos dang*/ spogs chog bogs 'don dang bcas pa ste gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas su bsgom pa gtso che zhing*/ spyir nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gyi gnas gnyis kar du bsgom ste/ lus gnad ngag gnad gnyis po sngar sor sdud kyi skabs dang 'dra/ sems gnad kyang mi g.yo bar 'jog tshul sogs phal cher 'dra mod kyis/ khyad par cung zad yod pa ni/ sngar sor sdud kyi skabs su ni/ stong gzugs ma mthong na lta ci smos/ mthong ba'i dus na'ang stong gzugs la sems mi 'jog par nam mkha' kho na la sems gtod pa yin la/ 'dir ni nam mkha' la sems 'jog pa'i tshab tu stong gzugs la sems 'jog pa ste/ stong gzugs mthong ba'i dus de nyid du/ rig pa stong gzugs la che re gtad cing*/ 'di yin 'di min sogs kyi dpyad pa dang*/ rnam rtog ye mi byed/ lta mkhan gyi rig pa kho rang gis rig ge ba kho rang la lta shes tsam bya'o/

/'di stong gzugs brtan pa thob nas sgom pa yin pas/ sgom la bzhag pa'i dus stong gzugs med pa cher mi yong la/ ci ste med pa'i skabs seng cung zad byung na/ sor sdud bzhin sgom/ stong gzugs g.yas g.yon steng 'og sogs su yal yol byed na yang de'i rjes su mig dang sems gnyis kar mi 'brang bar/ lta stangs dang rig pa thog ma'i gtod sa de khar gtod dgos/ de ltar byas pas sems gtod sa de khar rim gyis stong gzugs 'dus 'ong*/ de g.yo ba'i rjes su lta stangs dang sems 'brangs na/ byed bcing dang dmigs pa'i gnad 'chugs pas stong gzugs rang yang mi brtan par 'gro ba shas che/ ma song yang dmigs pa'i gnad la brtan pa mi thob pas re zhig lta stangs dang*/ /sems gtod sa g.yo med du byed pa gal che'o/ /dmigs bskor dgu pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ spogs chog dang*/ bogs 'don gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ bsam gtan stong gzugs drag tu sgom/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sor sdud kyi spogs chog ltar byed bcing drag po btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba de byed cing*/ dmigs pa yang stong gzugs kyi cha shas phra mo zhig gi dbus su sems zhugs 'gro ba lta bur drag tu gzir ba nyid do/ /dmigs bskor bcu pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba dang*/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang 'brel ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ye shes spyan sgrub las/ snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal bzung*/ /phra ba'i 'od la brten nas ni/ /rags pa'i 'od can ngo sprad pas/ /rtog med 'od las srid 'das snang*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag ni/ snang ba gsal po dang bcas pa'i phyogs su yang stong gzugs brtan po 'char na/ lta stangs sngar gyi las cung zad smad nas zhag gsum bzhi tsam bsgoms pa na/ sngar gyi las rtags snang cung zad mi gsal du 'gro yin 'dug na| da dung bogs 'don de sgom ma ran pa yin pas/ lta stangs steng de sngar bzhin zhag shas 'jur du sgom/

yang sngar bzhin lta stangs smad nas bsgoms pas/ de la stong gzugs brtan por yod/ de bzhin du rim gyis rim gyis lta stangs phab kyin bsgoms pas mi ring bar thad kar lta ba dang*/ thur du lta ba sogs thams cad la stong bzugs brtan por 'gro ste/ de nas rdo nag po'am/ bong ba la sogs pa mig la mi gnod pa'i dngos po ha cang che ba ma yin pa zhig rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ lta stangs kyi lam nas rim pas stong gzugs te dngos po de'i steng du phab la/ dngos po de yang mthong bzhin pa'i ngang nas stong gzugs la sems gzhur te sgom mo/ /de ltar bsgoms pas stong gzugs dang las snang gi dngos po gnyis kar cha mnyam du mthong gin 'dug na 'char tshul tha ma yin te/ bogs che rgyu med na'ang yun ring goms na gnad du 'gro/ 'ga' zhig de ma thag las snang gi dngos po de mi mthong bar/ 'od gsal gyi rtags de mthong ba zhig yong ste/ 'char tshul bzang bzang 'dra ste 'bring yin pas/ bskyed ha cang che ba mi yong*/ yang rtags snang dang las snang gnyis kar dus gcig tu yal te/ re zhig gang yang snang ba med pa zhig byung na myur du las snang 'gag cing*/ 'od gsal gyi snang ba rab 'byams 'char bar 'gyur/ 'di'i rigs bogs che zhing 'char sgo bzang ba yin no/ /rtags snang yal nas las snang 'dug pa'am/ rtags snang mi gsal du song zhing las snang gsal du song na/ bogs 'don bsgom ma ran pa yin pas/ dmigs pa'i rtsa ba nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de la goms nas dngos po rgya je che je che la bslabs pas/ mthar ri chen po sogs stong gzugs su 'char bas mtshon te snang ba thams cad la sbyar ro/ /dmigs bskor bcu gcig pa'o/ /dhū tī'i nang du 'od gsal gzung ba dang*/ srog rtsol gyi sgor 'od gsal bzung ba gnyis ni/ srog rtsol gyi gdams ngag dang 'brel ba yin zhing*/ bsam gtan la shin tu brtan pa thob pa yin na ma gtogs/ las dang po pas 'grub dka' bas skabs 'dir ma bshad do/

/stong pa'i sgra thos pa brtan po yod na/ las snang gi sgra dang bsres te/ 'bab chu'i sgra lta bu dang*/ stong pa'i sgra gnyis ka tshor bar byas te/ de gnyis mnyam po la sems gtad/ des 'bab chu'i sgra 'gags te stong pa'i sgra 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur/ de nas skye bo mang po 'dus pa'i sgra lta bu la sbyang*/ de nas gtam smra ba thams cad la sbyang*/ de nas rang gzhan gyi sgra thams cad la sbyangs pas/ sgra phal cher stong pa'i sgrar 'gyur/ 'dis dri ro reg bya gsum la'ang rigs 'gre mod/ re zhig ma smos so/ /dmigs bskor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sor sdud kyi skabs dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ nyal ba'i tshe stong gzugs nyid la sems gtad cing/ rnam rtog gis bar ma chod par gnyid du 'gro bar byas pas/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal myur du zin yod la/ stong gzugs rang lus kyi nang du 'char thub kyi yod na/ stong gzugs snying gar drangs nas/ de la sems gtad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar byas na/ dus de nyid du gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin par the tshom med do/ /dmigs bskor bcu gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la/ bsam gtan gyi mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lagabasgom pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgom pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/ dhyā na zhes pa dmigs pa la sems g.yo ba med pa'i don te/ de yang sgo gtan legs po btsud na/ sgo gleg khyar khyor du mi g.yo bar/ sgo 'byed gcod la rang dbang thob pa ltar/ dmigs pa la dbang bar byed pa'i don te/ dri med 'od las/ <yul stong gzugs lnga dang yul can stong gzugs mthong ba'i ye shes lnga bsam gtan gyi skabs 'dir gcig tu bsten par snang ba'i sgo nas yul sna tshogs pa'i stong gzugs la bsam gtan pa ste rtse gcig tu gnas so3gt;/ yul dang yul can bcu po rnams gcig nyid du sna tshogs gzugs la bsam gtan pa'o/

/zhes gsungs pas/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs 'od gsal de la sems rtse gcig tu byed cing*/ gnas pa dang 'gyu ba la rang ci 'dod du dbang thob par byed pa'i don te/ theg pa spyi ldog nas kyang bsam gtan gyi don dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sor sdud mthar phyin na rab yin la/ min na'ang 'od gsal gyi rtags snang brtan por shar ba'i dus so/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang mdor bstan las/ <blo bcos nas btags pa lta bu ma yin par >rma ི lam bzhin du gzugs mthong 'gyur/ /rtag tu gzugs de bsgom par bya/ /zhes bsam gtan gyi ngo bo ni/ 'od gsal rtags snang la rtse gcig tu dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ de'i yan lag ni/ bsdus rgyud las/ bsam gtan dag kyang shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa dga' dang g.yo med bde ba rtse gcig sems dpa' 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang 'od gsal rtags bcu la rtse gcig pa'i sems ni shes rab yin la/ ji skad du/ rtog pa zhes pa ni dngos po 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes pa'i dngos po'i ming can stong gzugs kyi mtshan nyid shes pa ni rtog pa yin la/ mtshan nyid shes tshul yang rang sems tsam yin par nyams su myong ba'o/ /sems nyid stong gzugs su shar ba de la gzung 'dzin nam/ yul yul can gyi rnam rtog dang spros pa'i mtshan ma gang gis kyang ma gos par myong zhing nges pa ni dpyod pa'i yan lag yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i sems kyi bde ba phyi la dmigs pa dang*/ nang la dmigs pa gnyis rim gyis 'byung ba'i phyi la dmigs pa ni sngar med kyi nom pa chen po rnyed pa ltar dga' zhing skyid snang shar ba ste bde ba'i yan lag yin la/ nang la dmigs pa ni ting nge 'dzin de nyid bde bar shar ba myong ba yin te g.yo med bde ba'i yan lag yin/ des rkyen byas nas lus la shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba khyad par can gyis khyab pa ni g.yo med bde ba'i yang phan yon no/

/de yang dang por shes rab rkyang pa skye/ de nas rtog pa dang gnyis ldan du 'byung*/ de bzhin du dpyod pa dang gsum ldan/ dga' ba dang bzhi ldan/ g.yo med bde ba dang lnga ldan du 'byung ste/ de tsam na bsam gtan gyi yan lag rdzogs par rgyud la skyes pa yin pas/ de nyid rgyun bsrings te bsgoms na mthar phyin pa'i yon tan rnams myur du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyud las/ de'i dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par <rtog btags lta bu'i yul dang bral ba ste yul ma yin par sna tshogs pa'i stong gzugs dwangs shing gsal ba'i bdag nyid du mthong ba'i don no3gt; bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis bsam gtan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtags bstan pa yin te/ rtags bcus bsdus pa srid pa gsum mtha' dag gi gzugs brnyan sngar song sdud skabs su mthong ba las ches lhag pa/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sna tshogs pa'i snang brnyan kha dog sna tshogs pa de dag kyang*/ 'od zer 'phro ba/ cha phra ba/ 'tsher ba/ 'dar ba/ gzhig par dka' ba/ zhes pa chos lnga ldan rnams thig le du mas mtshan pa mthong zhing*/ thig le'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan du ma 'char ba yin la/ de yang sems nyid dag pa'i snang bar rtogs pas/ kun rdzob las snang thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rang 'char ba yin te/ rgyud phyi ma las/ de la sems ni brtan pa'i bsam gtan gyis kyang phyi rol kyi ni dngos po rnam par spong bar byed/ /ces so/ /tshad ma ni sor sdud dang mtshungs pa las de'i rten dbang po ni lha'i spyan te/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan kyis mngon shes lnga 'grub pa'ang yin no/ /lnga pa la/ dag gzhi ni sngar sor sdud kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin yin la| dag bya la dbye na/ rnam shes kyi phung po

<nam mkha'i khams/ rna ba'i dbang po/ chos kyi skye mched/ gsang ba'i dbang po/ khu ba 'dor ba ste nam mkha'i khams pa drug > sogs phung khams nam mkha'i khams pa drug tshan gcig tu dbye/ dag byed bsam gtan gyi yan lag nyid la dbye na'ang yul can bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga dang*/ de'i yul stong gzugs lnga ste bcu'o/ /drug pa ni/ rgyud las/ mngon par shes pa lnga ni thob par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po bsam gtan sbyor bas dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bsam gtan mthar phyin pas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu mngon shes <rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ gzhan sems shes pa'i de sngon gnas mkhyen pa dang*/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i mngon shes so3gt; lnga rang shar du 'byung ba yin zhing*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu rgyal ba mi bskyod pa la <rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ phyag na rdo rje/ chos khams rdo rje ma/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ drag spyan ma ste lha nam mkha'i khams pa drug3gt; sogs pa lha nam mkha'i khams pa drug tshan gcig mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /'dir 'phros don gyi man ngag cung zad tsam brjod na/ shes rab kyi yan lag rgyud la skyes pas/ sems gang du gtad sar stong gzugs 'char ba zhig 'byung la/ de nas snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag bsgoms pas/ phyi rol kyi snang ba gang la sems bzhag pa der skad cig la las snang 'gags te 'od gsal gyi snang bar 'gyur ba zhig yod na/ des snga dro phyi dro'i dus su rang gcer bur phyung ba'i grib gzugs kyi snying ga la lta ba'am/ nyin gung ljon shing gi grib ma la lta bas kyang rung ste/ mig sbrid sbrid du g.yo ba med par lta/ de nas nam mkha' la bltas pas/ grib gzugs kyi rnam pa'i dbus su rtags snang dpag tu med par 'char/ zla ba drug tu 'di yang yang bsgoms pas sa 'og gi gter sogs kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du khang pa'i skar khung sogs la sbyangs pas/

khyim nang gi dngos po lkog gyur yang mthong pa yod cing*/ de bzhin du las snang gi sgra stong pa'i sgrar thim 'gro na/ stong pa'i sgra dang*/ 'gro ba sna tshogs pa'i skad bsres pa la mnyam par gzhag pa zla ba drug bsgoms pas rna ba'i mngon shes ci rigs par thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang gi snying ga chos 'khor gyi rtsa chu shing gi me tog lta bu'i nang du stong gzugs shar ba la sems gtad na sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran/ de nyid gzhan la spos na/ gzhan gyi sems shes te/ nyi ma la ni rgyab kyis phyogs nas/ zhes sogs dang*/ sgra ni gang zhig snying gi phyogs na zhes sogs rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ro/ /de ltar grib gzugs/ shing grib/ sgra skad/ rang dang gzhan gyi snying ga'i rtsa la dmigs pa ste/ lnga po 'di rnams dmigs phran yin pas dkyus kyi dmigs bskor la mi 'dren no/ /sgom don blo la 'god pa 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o/ /des bsam gtan gyi 'khrid tshar ro/ /re zhig srog rtsol man chad mi 'bogs shing*/ de tsam gyis chog shes par byed na/ rjes kyi 'khrid rnams skabs 'dir blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bar du dge ba'i 'khrid la/ las rlung a wa dhū tīr 'gag par byed pa dang*/ dbu ma'i nang du mi shigs pa'i thig le la thim par byed pa'i dbye ba gnyis te/ srog rtsol gyi 'khrid dang*/ 'dzin pa'i 'khrid do/ /dang po srog rtsol gyi 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang*/ sgom don blo la 'god pa'o/ /dang po la/ srog rtsol gyi yan lag dngos mtshan nyid tshang ba dang*/ srog rtsol rjes mthun pa las dang pos sgrub par bya ba gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /re zhig phyi ma'i dbang du byas nas bshad par bya ste/ de la paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ paṇa chen zla ba mgon po'i man ngag 'bro lugs su grags pa dang*/ jo bo sa manta shrī'i man ngag rwa lugs su grags pa ste/

gsum po 'di gzhung shing du bya la/ lugs gzhan thor bu pa rnams kyang phal cher de dag dang mthun zhing*/ cung zad khyad par yod pa rnams 'chad par yang 'gyur ro/ /de las paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag 'di la/ sngon 'gro rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa lam sbyang ba/ 'byongs nas 'jam rlung dgang gtong gi sbyor bas srog dbu mar gzhug pa/ zhugs nas rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor bas srog dbu mar 'ching ba/ ma chud cing ma 'chings na btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam dgag cing*/ bkag pas 'og sgo btsan thabs su 'gags na steng gi sbyor bas dgrol ba/ lce gsum bskyod pa'i sbyor bas nang gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ba/ gtum mo sbar ba'i sbyor bas srog thur bsre zhing 'chi med sgrub pa ste rdo rje'i tshig drug ces bya ba yin pa las/ dang po bzhi po srog rtsol gyi man ngag dang*/ phyi ma gnyis 'dzin pa'i man ngag tu mdzad do/ /skabs 'dir 'di ltar bya ste/ srog stsol gyi man ngag dngos dang*/ bogs 'don gegs sel dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la/ lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor gyi yi ge logs su bkod pa ltar/ sngon 'gro'i 'khrul 'khor dang bcas bzhin du 'di rnams sgom ste/ de yang paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi dbang du byas na/ sngar bshad pa'i rlung sbyor dang po gsum ste/ de la dang po rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa lam sbyang ba ni/ lta stangs kyi khyad par ni/ bgegs mthar byed dam bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lta stangs zhes bya ba/ thad ka las cung zad gyen du phyogs pa/ smin mtshams su hrig ger lta ba yin/ dmigs bsal can rnams ma gtogs srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi lta stangs thams cad 'di kho nar nges te/ rgyud las/ bgegs mthar byed pa'i lta ba bdud rtsi'i lam du son pa yis kyang nye bar sgrub pa yan lag drug/ces gsungs pas so/ /lus gnad gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal la/

dang por rlung phyi 'gro nang 'gro gnas pa gsum la sems ma 'khrul bar gtod de/ rdor bzlas kyi dmigs pa dang po'o/ /de nas rtsa gsum gsal gdab ste/ lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma sngaun po sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring bo tsam yar sna gtsug tor tu zugamar sna lte bar gnas pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po ste/ de gnyis dbu ma las ldab 'gyur gyis phra ba/ dbu ma dang gsum gshibs su 'dug par mos/ rlung phyir 'gro dus lte ba nas brtsams te dbu ma dang ro ma gnyis nas song*/ mgrin pa nas spyi bo'i bar gyi rtsa gnyis po'i cha thams cad nas thon/ sna bug nas phyir 'gro bar bsam/ nang du yong dus sna bug nas zhugs/ gtsug tor nas mgrin pa'i bar gyi dbu ma dang rkyang ma'i bar gyi cha thams cad nas thogs med du song ste/ rtsa gnyis po'i lam rgyud lte bar phyin/ gnas pa'i tshe dbu ma kho na'i nang gang bar bsam/ thog mar 'byung 'jug gnas gsum mnyam pa tsam byas pas/ rim gyi gnas pa je ring la 'gro'o/ /de yang sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i skabs yin na/ rlung rnams 'od dmar po dang*/ g.yon nas rgyu na dkar po dang*/ mnyam rgyur 'dug na ljang khu'am sngon po 'gro 'ong gnas gsum byed par sgom pa ste/ rdor bzlas kyi gnyis pa'o/ /'bud pa'i tshe sna bug g.yon 'gegs pa dang*/ rngub pa'i tshe g.yas 'gegs pa lag len kha cig la 'dug kyang*/ rdor bzlas kyi skabs de ltar mi dgos so/ /de nas sngar dang 'dra ba las phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'od zer āḥ'i sgra dang bcas pa/ 'od zer gyi sne la āḥyig dang bcas te 'gro ba dang*/ de nyid nang du 'ong ba'i tshe oṃ gyi sgra dang bcas pa/ tshur 'ong ba'i sne la oṃ yig dang bcas te 'ong bar bsam/ yi ge de gnyis kyang ro rkyang nas 'gro 'ong mi byed de dbu ma kho na nas 'gro bar bsam/ gnas pa'i skabs dbu ma'i nang na hūṃ gi sgra dang bcas shing lte bar hūṃ yig la sems gtad do/

/yi ge'i kha dog kyang rlung dang 'dra bar/ g.yas g.yon mnyam rgyu'i dbye bas dmar dkar sngo ba'o/ /de dag ni dmigs bcas kyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste/ rdor bzlas kyi gsum pa dang dngos gzhi yin la/ de gsum kar bsdoms pa dmigs chen gcig yin pas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs bskor bcu bzhi pa'o/ /da lta las dang po pa'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ 'di lta bu las 'os med la/ don dam rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rlung gi 'gro 'ong gnas gsum dang*/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo dbyer med du shes pa na ming tshig brjod pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i ming ngo*/ /gnyis pa 'jam rlung dgang gtong gi sbyor bas srog dbu mar gzhug pa ni/ rlung gang nas rgyu brtags te/ sna bug g.yon nas rgyu na/ lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mos mchan khung g.yon nu ma dang bcas te bsdams pa'i steng nas/ bar lhu g.yon pas mnan/ rlung ro bsal/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mos sna bug g.yas pa bkag sna bug g.yon nas rlung shugs che la ring bar rngubs te lte bar mnan/ cung zhig bsdams nas mi bde ba 'byung tshad pa nas/ sna bug g.yon mdzum mo g.yon pas bkag nas/ gdong g.yas su phyogs pas sna g.yas nas rlung drag tu 'bud/ yang sna bug g.yas pa bkag g.yon nas rngubs pa sogs gong bzhin bskyar gyin sbyang*/ 'di skabs rkang pa brkyang bskum gyi 'dug stangs bshad na'ang skyil krung nyid kyis chog la/ 'og rlung rang gnas su bcings dgos shing*/ des rlung sna bug g.yas su 'pho ba'am/ mnyam rgyur 'gyur ba dang*/ yang sna bug g.yas nas rgyun phyag rgya de nyid go bzlog pas g.yon rgyu'am mnyam rgyur 'gyur ba dang*/ g.yas g.yon phan tshun du lan 'ga' re spos na nges par mnyam rgyur 'gyur la/ mnyam rgyur song nas lugs 'di la rdor bzlas byed cing*/ yang g.yas g.yon du yo na/ snga ma'i sbyor bas yon po srong ngo*/ /zhes bzhed la/ 'on kyang mnyam rgyur nam song ba'i tshe/

dgang ba'i rnal 'byor ram/ bum can bsgoms na bzang bas/ bar 'dir dgang ba'i rlung sbyor zhig bcug na legs par mthong ngo*/ /'di tshe ring po sgrub pa la lhag par bsngags so/ /dmigs bskor bco lnga pa'o/ /gsum pa rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor bas srog rlung dbu mar 'ching ba ni/ thog ma nas mnyam rgyur 'dug na legs/ yon por 'dug na gong gi sbyor bas mnyam rgyur btang ste/ rkang pa zlum po'i 'dug stangs dang*/ lag pa khu tshur snying gar bsnol bar bshad na'ang*/ rkang pa skyil krung gi steng nas byas pas chogagayas g.yon dbus gsum nas/ rlung ro dal ba dang*/ drag po dang*/ shin tu drag po'i tshul gyis lan gsum gsum ste/ dgu phrugs su bus/ 'di skabs thur sel gyi rlung 'then gyis bya/ de nas steng rlung cung zad myur bar rngubs te lte bar bskyur stabs su mnan pa dang lhan cig mchil ma mid/ de rjes thur sel g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas drangs te/ kha sbyor lte bar thub tshad bzung*/ mi thub pa 'dra na phyir ma shor bar rngubs chung lan gsum byas te mnan/ de nas kyang mi thub pa 'dug na dal bus phyir btang la mthar sangs te 'bud do/ / 'dir lag len bzhin pus mo la bskor te se gol gtogs pa so drug khegs na tha ma/ don gnyis khegs na 'bring*/ brgya brgyad khegs na chen po'o zhes grags so/ /'di dag la dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ lus nang du 'od gsal rtags snang 'char na lte bar stong gzugs shar ba la sems gtod pa yin/ de bzhin ma yin na/ sems stong gzugs gang du shar sa der gtod cing*/ ma shar ba'i bar bar la blos bcos te sgom pa'i dmigs rten ni mi dgos/ lus kyi dbus lte ba'i thad tsam du sems kyi gtad so tsam bya'o/ /dmigs bskor bcu drug pa'o/ /paṇa chen zla mgon gyi man ngag 'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ni/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ dgug pa dang*/

dgang ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rdul mtha' can te lnga yod pa las/ phyi ma spogs chog yin pas man ngag dngos gzhi snga ma bzhi'o/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ ro rkyang nas 'gro ba'i dmigs pa mi mdzad/ g.yas g.yon mnyam rgyu gang yin yang 'dra ste/ phyir 'gro ba dmar po/ nang du 'jug pa dkar po/ gnas pa nag por sgom pa dang*/ rdor bzlas kyi sngon 'gro gnyis po mi dgos pa'o/ /'di snga ma dang don gcig pas dmigs bskor logs par mi 'dren no/ /rdor bzlas 'di grub chen yu mo'i dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi sbyor drug na gsal bar yod/ spyir 'bro ba gong ma rnams bum pa can nyid la rdor bzlas tshang bar bzhed de rgyud don dang shin tu 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa dgug pa ni/ sna bug g.yas nas rlung rgyu ba'i skabs lta stangs cung zad g.yas phyogs su bsgyur zhing*/ rlung nang du dal bus drangs nas gsang gnas su mnan la thub tshad du bsdams/ mi thub na sud tsam sud tsam bar bcad kyin bcad kyin mthar sangs kyis btang ngo*/ /dmigs bskor bcu bdun pa'o/ /gsum pa dgang ba ni/ sna bug g.yon nas rlung rgyu ba'i tshe/ lta stangs cung zad g.yon du bsgyur/ nang du cung zad mgyogs par shar te rngubs la/ gsus pa ldir gyis dgang*/ gtong ba sngar dang 'dra/ dmigs bskor bco brgyad pa'o/ /bzhi pa rengs pa ni/ sngar gyi 'jam rlung dgang gtong dang phyogs mtshungs shing*/ lugs 'di'i bum pa can yang 'dis 'grub par bzhed la/ don la'ang 'jam rlung gi bum can yin no/ /de yang rlung ro bsal la sna bug g.yon nas rgyu na lta stangs g.yas su bsgyur/ 'og sgo bsdams g.yas nas dal la ring bar rngubs te/ gsang gnas su bzung la/ mthar g.yas nas btang*/ g.yas nas rgyu na lta stangs g.yon du bsgyur/ g.yon nas dal bus rngubs/ 'og sgo bsdams/ lto ba ldir gyis bya/ mthar g.yon nas btang ngo*/ /de ltar re mos su spel gyin sgom/

mnyam rgyur 'dug na lta stangs thad kar byas la myur bar rngubs/ lte bar kha sbyor drag po'i ngang nas lto ba cung zad tshigs pa la gcer/ phyir dal bus gtong*/ de ltar na bum pa can te dmigs bskor bcu dgu pa'o/ /lugs 'di yang srog rtsol kyi man ngag cha tshang ba gcig go /grub chen man lung ba'i bzhed pa yin gsungs/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal dang bu ston sogs gong mas bskyar bzlos mdzad pa de yang phal cher 'di dang 'dra'o/ /rwa lugs kyi man ngag ni/ dang po srog rlung dngos gzhug pa ni/ lus gnad sogs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ dang por sna bug g.yas lta bu zhig mdzub mos bkag nas rlung bus shing rngubs/ 'og rlung bag tsam bsdams pa'i bum pa can bzung*/ yang sna bug g.yon bkag g.yas nas 'bud cing bzung ba sogs bum can 'dzin pa g.yas g.yon spel gyin sgom/ dmigs bskor nyi shu pa'o/ /thur sel gyi rlung dngos su gzhug pa ni/ steng rlung snga ma bzhin du byas la/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum drag po'i sbyor bas oṃ āḥdang lhan cig drag tu 'then pa de steng rlung dang lhan cig gsang gnas su gzir bar bya'o/ /'di'i man ngag gi yi ge las/ srog dang thur sel gyi bum can ste 'khor lo gzhan rnams su'ang drag tu 'dren par bshad de/ lte bar brtan pa thob pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ de bzhin du srog rlung gi bum can bco brgyad 'gyur thur sel gyi bum can la byed pa sogs kyang rlung la dbang thob pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pas/ de dag re zhig las dang po pa la mi dgos shing*/ 'ga' zhig rang shugs kyis 'grub la/ 'ga' zhig zhar la 'og tu ston par yang 'gyur ro/ /dmigs bskor nyer gcig pa'o/ /'dir yang de tsam kyis skabs 'di'i srog rtsol gyi man ngag cha tshang bar 'gyur la/ sngar gyi 'phros las mnyam gnas kyi rlung gzhug pa ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las sna bug gnyis kar nas 'bud rngub bya/ gtsug tor ma gtogs pa'i 'khor lo lnga dang*/

yan lag nying lag gi rlung rnams thams cad gcig tu 'dus par bsam zhing*/ oṃ zhes 'og sgo drag tu bsdams la steng du drangs/ āḥzhes 'og sgo dbye bas thur du bsdigs pa dang*/ gyen rgyu gzhug pa de dang 'dra ba las/ mgrin pa dang ro stod drag tu gcud/ khyab byed gzhug pa yang de dang 'dra ba las sor mo rnams bskum/ nya bzhi sgrim mo zhes bshad na'ang*/ de gsum po yan lag gi dmigs pa yin pa dang*/ deng sang nyams khrid mi skyong bas dmigs bskor logs par mi 'dren no/ /man lung ba'i mtshan brjod sbyor drug gi lugs ni/ dal bus rngub pa na oṃ kyi yid bzlas dang*/ kha sbyor bum can rngub chung dang bcas te 'dzin pa na hūṃ gi yid bzlas dang*/ dal bus rgyu ba mi mngon pa tsam du 'bud pa na āḥ'i yid bzlas bya bar bzhed de/ 'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyang don gyis 'di nyid bzhed do/ /'di ni rlung sbyor gcig la rdor bzlas bum can gnyis ka tshang ba'i lugs te/ shin tu legs par mngon no/ /de bzhin du/ gyi co/ khrom lo/ tsa mi/ rga lo sogs lugs gzhan gyi dgang ba dang*/ dbyung ba dang*/ bum pa can rnams kyang de rnams la don tshang bar shes pas logs su bshad mi dgos so/ /'di thams cad la thun mong du man ngag sbyar ba ni/ rlung phyir 'gro dus rtags snang la drag tu sems gtad/ nang du 'jug dus sems nyid dang bsre/ gnas pa'i dus su sems dang stong gzugs bsres pa'i myong ba dang 'dzin pa de bshig par bya ste/ shin tu zab pa'i nyams len ting nge 'dzin sems kyi gnad rna ba nas rna ba dang*/ zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa rgyud gzhung tshad ldan kun gyi dgongs pa rma med pa'o/ /dmigs bskor nyer gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa la spogs chog bogs 'don dang*/ srog rtsol nyid kyi sgo nas gegs bsal ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ ma chud cing ma 'chings na/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam dgag pa ni spogs chog yin te/

paṇa chen shākya shrī'i bzhed pas/ lus gnad lta stangs spyi dang mthun par bcas/ rlung ro bsal rjes rlung rang sor bzhag rtsa bzang na lag pa gnyis gang rung gcig gi mtheb mdzub kyis mgrin pa'i 'phar rtsa mnan/ rtsa ngan na g.yas kyi mthe bos g.yas kyi 'phar rtsa dang*/ g.yon gyi mthe bos g.yon gyi 'phar rtsa mnan/ sor mo lhag ma rnams kyis ltag pa nas rten te/ ran par gtsir bas/ rab la bde stong gi nyams dang 'od gsal gyi nyams khyad par can skye/ 'bring la rnam rtog 'gag cing rtags snang gsar pa cung zad 'char/ tha ma la'ang rnam rtog cung zad 'gag go /dang por shugs chung ba mi 'gyel tsam du mnan zhing*/ phyis shugs je drag je drag tu mnan pas nyams je bzang je bzang du 'gyur ro/ /'bro lugs kyi man ngag las ni/ 'di la rdul mtha' can zer zhing*/ rting pa g.yas pas bshang lam dgag brla dang byin pa'i bar du gsang rtsa ltem pa'am/ rting pa g.yon pas gsang rtsa ltem/ lag pa phyogs gcig gdan la brten/ cig shos kyis gnyid log mnan/ rlung yongs rdzogs bzung ba'am/ cung zad cig phyir btang ba'i lhag ma bzung ba gang bde bya/ zhes bshad do/ /'di las 'phros pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni 'og tu bstan par bya'o/ /dmigs bskor nyer gsum pa'o/ /bogs 'don ni/ ye shes spyan sgrub las 'byung ba'i man ngag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dhū tī'i nang du 'od gsal bzung*/ /rtogs med sems kyi de nyid shes/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi de nyid mthong*/ /gsang sngags chos la mkhas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ bum pa can dang stong gzugs la mnyam par bzhag pa yang yang goms pas lus kyi nang du stong gzugs 'char/ de'i rgyun goms pas lus kyi nang gang 'dod du 'char thub/ de skabs nas/ lte ba sprul 'khor gyi dbus dbu ma gang du yod pa'i thad de tsam du stong gzugs shar ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad pas drod tsha 'ur ba sogs bde drod kyi nyams 'phral du shar byung na gnad du song ba yin/
